name: Service Gallery / Return
hint: The service gallery has changed. The enlarging room is ahead.

decor.title: Wren / Release
decor.text:
If a print can choose to leave, it is no longer an item.
Keep the archive. Open the doors. — W.A.

start: You recognize the gallery. The staff mounts are empty now.
I released their accession locks. I thought it might make you stay.
zone:bay: Those sleeves protect my emulsion suspension straps. A loaded counterweight draws them up.
Wren used negative film to clean the straps once. I asked her to stop.
door: I kept the first portrait because she asked. The rest because I was afraid.
Come through. There is something I need you to understand.
nudge: The gallery shutter is already open. Follow the service rail.
nudge2: The doorway at the far end leads to the enlarging room.
